note: Olli requested three bounded homepage changes: centre the GH-S04 workflow as a complete visual group, move the existing review proof directly under the hero in a very simple marquee-like treatment, and remove the two-sentence dependency line from GH-S02 while retaining the stronger operating-layer close.

sections.title: The problem
sections.feedback: Delete the complete close: 'External tools can create real value. Dependency without ownership does not. Your business needs an operating layer it controls.' It feels out of place.

sections.title: Built on ourselves first
sections.feedback: The visual does not feel centre-aligned as one whole group. Centre the complete workflow rather than leaving its weight offset to the left.

sections.title: Proof from the first Mez System
sections.feedback: Put a review section directly under the hero, like a marquee, with a super simple design.

selected.reviewComposition: A static testimonial-proof rail directly below GH-S01. Three existing attributed review excerpts sit in one horizontal strip with hairline separators and no card chassis.
selected.reviewMotion: The rail has a marquee silhouette but does not move. MOT-04 keeps Wings, type and layout static.
selected.sequenceAlignment: Each of the five GH-S04 markers moves to the centre of its grid column. The first and last marker centres are therefore symmetric around the page axis, and one connector formula reaches every marker.
selected.problemClose: The complete two-part dependency and operating-layer close is removed. GH-S02 now ends on the staircase.
